newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Union Bank closes US$75 mln FRCD.
newsitem.headline: Union Bank closes US$75 mln FRCD.

text.p: A group has formed for Union Bank of the Philippines' US$75 million floating rate certificates of deposit issue due 2001, said bookrunner Merrill Lynch International.
The certificates were issued and re-offered at par to float at 85 basis points over the three-month London Interbank Offered Rate. There is a put option on the third anniversary.
With fees, the all-in returns for top-tier manager is 93 basis points.
Joint-lead managers are Dresdner (South East Asia), LTCB Asia and Standard Chartered Bank, with US$15 million each, and Merril Lynch International, with US$16 million.
Co-lead managers, with US$5 million each, are Deutsche Morgan Grenfell and Nomura International (Hong Kong).
Co-managers, with US$2 million each, are Development Bank of Singapore and Far Eastern International Bank's Offshore Banking branch.
